agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MEETING AGENDA
May 1, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for April 3, 2024, Planning Commission
  meeting(s).

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Alfred Davis,
  representing Alfred Davis & Associates for Special Use Permit
  No. 24-00003 (SUP24-00003) to allow a 770 square-foot tattoo
  parlor in a multi-tenant building on an approximately 37,700
  square-foot, C-2A (Airport Commercial)zoned property at 4233
  West Century Boulevard.
  Planning Commission Actions:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2024-040.
  2) Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP24-00003.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions and modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Deny the SUP and make the appropriate findings.
  Item 6a Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere considered
  on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).
"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."
In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of May 1, 2024, is not
held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 5, 2024, 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
